Reading notes

Bulk post-mortem tissue mixes cell types, so changes can reflect neuron loss or gliosis rather than per-cell regulation. Meta-analysis pools strata of one disease; brain regions from the same donors are not independent, so pooled p-values are optimistic. Transcript changes are hypotheses for lipid measurement, not lipid measurements.
